scope: Published NPY and retrieval metadata compared with fixed official sampling code; synthetic CPU branch reproduction, no raw video decode.

code_branch_reproduction.meaning: Official frames==0 branch selects the first maxlen frame indices, not uniformly across the known video duration.

interpretation.confirmed: All released MKV NPY records report 64 source/output frames with sequential indices; matching embedding records report more frames and wider source sampling. Official unknown-frame-count fallback reproduces the sequential selection.
interpretation.inference: Release metadata is consistent with the unknown-frame-count fallback and possible first-64-frame extraction. Exact original extraction version and raw-video frame content were not independently decoded; do not equate the recorded 2.67s with true original clip duration.
interpretation.baseline_decision: Retain official arrays, annotations, sampling and timestamps for this smoke. No guessed FPS, duration or GT fix. Engineering smoke success does not resolve paper-frame-coverage alignment.
